D/ IVL CRISPVS NOB CAES ; R/ BEAT TRANQVILLITAS

Copper alloy nummus of Crispus Diameter 18mm, weight 3.05g Obverse: laureate cuirassed bust facing left, holding spear & shield Obverse inscription: IVL CRISPVS NOB CAES Reverse: altar inscribed VOT-IS-XX, globe & three stars above, STR in ex Reverse inscription: BEAT TRANQVILLITAS Mint: Trier (Germany) Condition: very fine
